title: AnyMo: Scaling Any-Modality Conditional Motion Generation with Masked Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2605.29488v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Conditional human motion generation remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision and robotics. Despite significant progress, current methods are often constrained by fixed modality configurations and task-specific architectures, leaving cross-modal interactions and the scaling laws of multimodal-conditioned synthesis largely underexplored. A key bottleneck is the scarcity of large-scale modality-aligned motion data, limiting generalization across diverse control signals. In this work, we introduce OmniHuMo, a large-scale, high-quality dataset comprising over 5,000 hours of motion and 3.2 million sequences with precisely aligned multimodal annotations (e.g., text, speech, music, and trajectory). Leveraging OmniHuMo, we propose AnyMo, a unified multimodal framework combining a Residual FSQ-based motion tokenizer with a scalable masked modeling transformer, enabling high-quality motion synthesis under arbitrary modality comb

translated_title: AnyMo：基于掩码建模的任意模态条件动作生成扩展
translated_abstract: 条件人体动作生成仍然是计算机视觉和机器人领域的一项基本挑战。尽管已取得显著进展，现有方法通常受限于固定的模态配置和任务特定的架构，导致跨模态交互以及多模态条件合成的缩放规律在很大程度上仍未被充分探索。一个关键瓶颈是大规模模态对齐动作数据的稀缺，这限制了对多样化控制信号的泛化能力。在本工作中，我们提出了OmniHuMo——一个大规模、高质量的数据集，包含超过5,000小时的动作和320万个序列，并配有精确对齐的多模态标注（如文本、语音、音乐和轨迹）。基于OmniHuMo，我们提出了AnyMo，一个统一的多模态框架，它将基于残差FSQ的动作分词器与可扩展的掩码建模Transformer相结合，能够在任意模态组合下实现高质量的动作合成。
tldr: 该论文提出了包含5,000多小时动作数据的大规模多模态数据集OmniHuMo，以及结合残差FSQ动作分词器与可扩展掩码建模Transformer的统一框架AnyMo，实现了任意模态组合条件下的高质量人体动作生成。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OmniHuMo, a large-scale multimodal motion dataset with over 5,000 hours of data, and AnyMo, a unified framework combining a Residual FSQ motion tokenizer with a scalable masked modeling transformer, enabling high-quality human motion generation under arbitrary modality combinations.
